repo_notes.content: Put some furry joke and use some furry language on every page, not too much, just a bit.

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce the puppet-home repository, explaining its purpose as a home infrastructure automation system using Puppet for configuration management, and providing a high-level map of the major subsystems

page_notes.content: Mention that this code has been developed by Taiku Drolf. Mention the website taiku.cz, you can cross-link the social links too. Watch out for the Network topology diagram. On the Network Topology and VLAN Design page, it is correct, but wasn't here in the Overview.

pages.title: Infrastructure Architecture
pages.purpose: Describe the overall infrastructure design, including network segmentation, the .den TLD namespace, VLAN topology, and how major subsystems (monitoring, DNS, configuration management) interact

pages.title: Network Topology and VLAN Design
pages.purpose: Document the VLAN segmentation strategy (VLANs 20-50), explain the purpose of each network segment (management, data, services, user, public, DMZ), and describe the dual-interface pattern used by infrastructure hosts

pages.title: Monitoring and Observability Stack
pages.purpose: Provide an overview of the complete monitoring architecture, including Prometheus for metrics, Loki for logs, Alertmanager for notifications, and Grafana for visualization

pages.title: Configuration Management Architecture
pages.purpose: Explain the Puppet-based configuration management system, including the primary/secondary master topology, Keepalived HA setup, Hiera data hierarchy, and the role/profile pattern

pages.title: DNS Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Document the BIND9-based DNS system providing the .den TLD, including zone structure, name server configuration, and the relationship between DNS domains and network VLANs

pages.title: BIND9 Configuration and Zone Files
pages.purpose: Detail the BIND9 configuration including named.conf structure, zone definitions, SOA records, and the organization of forward and reverse lookup zones

pages.title: Zone Structure and Record Types
pages.purpose: Explain the DNS zone hierarchy (.den, mgmt.den, data.den), document the record types used (A, CNAME, PTR, NS), and describe the mapping between zones and VLANs

pages.title: View-Based Resolution and RPZ
pages.purpose: Document the view-based DNS configuration (vlan21-view vs default), explain how different clients receive different zone data, and describe the Response Policy Zone (RPZ) for DNS overrides

pages.title: Monitoring and Observability
pages.purpose: Comprehensive documentation of the monitoring stack, covering metric collection, alert rules, log aggregation, and visualization, with emphasis on the 95+ alert rules and diverse exporter ecosystem

pages.title: Prometheus Server Configuration
pages.purpose: Document the Prometheus server setup, including scrape configurations for all exporters, global settings, remote write configuration, and integration with Alertmanager

pages.title: Exporters and Metric Collection
pages.purpose: Detail all metric exporters deployed (node_exporter, blackbox_exporter, snmp_exporter, pihole_exporter, etc.), their configuration, scrape jobs, and the metrics they expose

pages.title: Alert Rules and Notification
pages.purpose: Comprehensive documentation of the 95+ alert rules across system health, application monitoring, and predictive alerting, including the Alertmanager routing/inhibition configuration and Telegram integration

pages.title: Log Aggregation with Loki and Promtail
pages.purpose: Document the log collection pipeline, including Promtail's syslog listener, label extraction, Loki storage configuration, and log-based alerting rules

pages.title: Grafana Visualization
pages.purpose: Document Grafana deployment, configuration (grafana.ini), Nginx reverse proxy setup, and integration with Prometheus and Loki data sources

pages.title: Configuration Management with Puppet
pages.purpose: Detailed documentation of the Puppet infrastructure, including master/agent architecture, code organization (roles/profiles), Hiera data hierarchy, and catalog compilation process

pages.title: Puppet Master Setup and HA
pages.purpose: Document the primary/secondary Puppet master configuration, CA synchronization via rsync, Keepalived VIP setup, and the prometheus_reporter integration for monitoring

pages.title: Base System Configuration
pages.purpose: Document the profile::base class and its included profiles, covering network setup, timezone configuration, syslog provider selection, swap management, and the hardware-specific log2ram optimization

pages.title: Package Management
pages.purpose: Document the package management system including custom APT repository setup (build.den), GPG key management, essential package installation, and the Exim4 mail relay configuration

pages.title: System Services and Logging
pages.purpose: Document system service configuration including syslog (busybox vs rsyslog with Promtail relay), systemd-journald volatile storage, log2ram for reducing disk writes, and logcheck removal

pages.title: Security and Access Control
pages.purpose: Document the security configuration including PAM access control (access.conf), SSH hardening, file permissions, and the taiku user management network restrictions

pages.title: Service Deployments
pages.purpose: Overview of all deployed services, categorized by function (infrastructure, network, media, storage), and the deployment patterns used (bare metal, LXC, Kubernetes)

pages.title: Kubernetes and Container Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Document the k3s Kubernetes cluster (3x Raspberry Pi), LXD container hosts, the temporary ingress configuration, multi-interface networking pattern, and container-specific monitoring configurations

pages.title: Network Services
pages.purpose: Document network infrastructure services including Pi-hole ad-blocking DNS (HA pair), Postfix SMTP relay with OpenDKIM signing, and their integration with monitoring

pages.title: Media and Storage Services
pages.purpose: Document media-related services including Transmission BitTorrent daemon with cache warmer, Samba NAS file sharing, and the Couchpotato media management application

pages.title: Role and Profile Catalog
pages.purpose: Comprehensive catalog of all Puppet roles and profiles, documenting their purpose, included profiles, and usage patterns across the infrastructure

pages.title: Deployment and Maintenance Procedures
pages.purpose: Document operational procedures including initial node deployment, Puppet agent bootstrap, certificate signing, code deployment workflow, and common maintenance tasks
